## About the Founder — Nic Butts

Nic Butts founded Summit Marketing in 2026 after spending 2+ years in the home services industry and seeing the same problem repeated: businesses weren't losing because of a lack of leads — they were losing because they lacked the right systems. Jobs went to whoever called back first, and most contractors were calling back the next day, not the next minute.

Nic built Summit Marketing to install the systems that change that outcome. His background combines hands-on home services experience with digital marketing expertise, and his mission is straightforward: help Mississippi contractors stop losing booked jobs to slow response times and missed calls.

Nic holds a degree in Marketing from the University of Mississippi and ran marketing operations for home service companies before starting Summit Marketing.

---

## The Contractor Revenue Engine

Summit Marketing's signature system — the Contractor Revenue Engine — consists of five interconnected components:

### System 1: Lead Capture
Every lead from every channel (phone, form, text, social DM, referral) is captured and centralized. No lead falls through the cracks because there's no crack for it to fall through.

### System 2: 5-Minute Response
The first company to respond wins the job — research shows 78% of customers go with the first company to call back. Our automated 5-Minute Lead Response system ensures every new lead gets contacted within 5 minutes, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

### System 3: AI Receptionist & Sales Assistant
A 24/7 AI Receptionist trained on the contractor's company knowledge base answers calls, qualifies leads, books appointments, handles FAQs, and routes jobs — even at midnight on a Sunday. The AI Sales Assistant follows up on unbooked estimates and revives cold leads automatically.

### System 4: Reputation System
After every completed job, automated review requests go out at the moment of highest satisfaction. More 5-star reviews mean more calls, better rankings, and higher perceived quality — all on autopilot.

### System 5: Business Intelligence Dashboard
Real-time visibility into lead source, response time, booking rate, and revenue — so the owner always knows what's working and where to double down.

## Web Design Services

Every Summit Marketing website is built conversion-first, with SEO baked in from day one.

### Trailhead — $300–$2,000
5–10 page template-based website. Fast turnaround, mobile-first, clean design. Ideal for contractors who need a professional web presence quickly.

### Pinnacle — $2,000–$5,000 (Most Popular)
Fully custom-designed website. Unique to your brand, conversion-optimized, and built to rank. Most popular for growing contractors.

### Apex — $5,000–$20,000+
Complex builds: multi-location sites, e-commerce integration, advanced automation, custom portals. Built for businesses with complex digital requirements.

All websites include: conversion-first design, built-in SEO, Core Web Vitals optimization, CRM/GHL integration, Google Analytics, schema markup, and full marketing stack integration.

## AI & Automation Services

Summit Marketing does not run paid advertising (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Facebook Ads). Instead, Summit Marketing specializes in AI-powered organic growth and automation:

- **AI Receptionist**: A 24/7 virtual receptionist trained on your specific company — your services, prices, service areas, FAQs, and booking process. Handles inbound calls, qualifies leads, books appointments, and answers customer questions at any hour.
- **AI Sales Assistant**: Proactively follows up on unbooked estimates with personalized messages, revives cold leads, and sends appointment reminders.
- **Chatbot with Company Knowledge Base**: Embeds on your website and answers visitor questions instantly using your specific business information, reducing friction and capturing leads 24/7.
- **Voice AI**: Inbound and outbound AI voice calls for lead qualification, appointment reminders, and follow-up.
- **Missed Opportunity Recovery**: When a call goes unanswered or a lead doesn't book, an automated follow-up goes out within seconds so no lead falls through the cracks.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What does Summit Marketing do?**
A: Summit Marketing builds the Contractor Revenue Engine — an automated system that captures every lead, responds within 5 minutes, and books more jobs for home service contractors in Mississippi. We install lead capture systems, AI receptionists, follow-up automation, and reputation management so that no lead ever falls through the cracks.

**Q: How much does Summit Marketing cost?**
A: Retainer plans start at $697/month (Basecamp), with Elevate at $1,297/month, Ascent at $1,997/month, and Peak starting at $3,250/month. Annual billing saves approximately 15%. All plans have a one-time onboarding fee ($1,500–$3,000 depending on plan). Web design projects start at $300.

**Q: Does Summit Marketing run paid ads?**
A: No. Summit Marketing does not manage Google Ads, Meta Ads, or any paid advertising. We focus exclusively on organic growth, AI automation, and revenue systems — approaches that compound over time rather than stopping the moment you stop paying.

**Q: Who does Summit Marketing work with?**
A: Primarily home service contractors in Mississippi — HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, landscaping, pest control, cleaning, and similar businesses. We also work with local businesses across all industries that need better lead capture and follow-up systems.

**Q: Where is Summit Marketing located?**
A: Pearl, Mississippi (greater Jackson metro area). We serve businesses throughout Mississippi — Jackson, Gulfport, Biloxi, Hattiesburg, Tupelo, Southaven, Meridian, and beyond — as well as clients across the Southeast United States.

**Q: Are there contracts?**
A: No long-term contracts. Summit Marketing operates on a month-to-month basis. We earn continued business through results, not lock-ins.

**Q: How long does it take to see results?**
A: The lead capture and follow-up systems activate within the first week of onboarding. Clients typically see improved lead response rates and booking rates in the first 30 days. SEO and organic visibility improvements compound over 3–6 months.

**Q: What is AEO and why does it matter?**
A: AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) is the practice of optimizing your business to appear in answers from AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overview. When a homeowner asks an AI "who's the best HVAC company in Jackson MS," AEO determines whether your business gets mentioned. Summit Marketing optimizes for both traditional SEO and AEO simultaneously.

**Q: Does Summit Marketing offer an AI Receptionist?**
A: Yes. The AI Receptionist is included in the Ascent ($1,997/month) and Peak ($3,250+/month) plans. It's a 24/7 AI trained specifically on your business — your services, service area, pricing, and booking process — that answers calls, qualifies leads, books appointments, and handles FAQs at any hour of the day or night.

**Q: How is Summit Marketing different from other marketing agencies?**
A: Most agencies sell activity (posts, reports, campaigns). Summit Marketing sells outcomes — booked jobs. The Contractor Revenue Engine is built specifically for home service contractors, with AI-powered tools that work 24/7 so you never miss a lead, even when you're on a job site or asleep.

## Service Areas — Detailed

### Jackson, MS
Mississippi's capital and largest city. Summit Marketing helps Jackson-area contractors capture more leads and compete in the metro's high-volume home services market.

### Flowood, MS
Rankin County hub with strong residential and commercial markets. High home values and active remodeling market make Flowood an excellent target for home service contractors.

### Madison, MS
Affluent north Jackson suburb. Premium demographics mean higher average job values and strong demand for quality home services.

### Ridgeland, MS
Major commercial corridor and growing residential market. Interstate proximity drives significant search traffic.

### Brandon, MS
Rankin County seat with rapidly growing residential population. Active new construction and home improvement market.

### Gulfport, MS
Mississippi Gulf Coast's largest city. Coastal climate drives consistent demand for HVAC, roofing, and pest control services.

### Biloxi, MS
Gulf Coast tourism and residential market. Mix of vacation properties and permanent residences creates diverse service needs.

### Hattiesburg, MS
South Mississippi hub and university city. Strong residential market with steady year-round demand.

### Southaven, MS
DeSoto County's largest city. Memphis metro overflow creates high-density residential market with strong purchasing power.

### Tupelo, MS
Northeast Mississippi's largest city. Manufacturing and residential growth drive consistent home services demand.
